latest.title: Updates for July 7, 2026
latest.body:
- Overhaul ,stream with station switching and queue controls
- Fix radio playback using fetch and demuxProbe
- Align marketing site with pricing and fix radio reconnect loop
- Fix duplicate command replies using site_settings dedup
- Update July 7 changelog with stream, pricing, and dedup fixes
- Fix duplicate command replies across bot instances
- Add ,stream command for Icecast and Shoutcast radio playback
- Overhaul pricing page with bot stack comparison and switch incentives
- Prevent duplicate changelog embeds on bot startup
- Remove false-negative changelog permission preflight check
- Fix changelog embed sync skipping posts on first bot run
- Fix bot crash by excluding .d.ts files from command loader
